facts.text: Cloud Migration Setup guided wizard configures components for migrating data from on-premises to Business Central online.
User running setup must have Microsoft 365 tenant admin and Business Central admin rights.
Delegated administrators need approval from licensed user with SUPER permissions.
Review cloud migration prerequisites and create table mappings if needed.
Sign into Microsoft 365 tenant and Business Central online environment.
Open Cloud Migration Setup and accept warnings, then select product version.
Define SQL database connection and integration runtime settings.
Select companies to migrate or choose all companies.
